थ: थ 1. थ, the second consonant of the dental class and the aspirate of the preceding letter, having much the sound of थ् in अन्त्-हिल्ल्, but more dental. —थ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound थ्।
2. थ, अस्, m. a mountain; a protector, preserver; a sign of danger; a kind of disease; eating; (अम्), n. preserving, preservation; fear, terror; auspicious-ness; a prayer for the welfare of another.
थक्कन: थक्कन थक्कन, अस्, m., N. of a man; (also read ढक्कन and ढक्कम।)
थक्कियक: थक्कियक थक्कियक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
थक्रिय: थक्रिय थक्रिय, अस्, m., N. of a man.
थर्व्: थर्व् थर्व् (said to be = rt. चर्), cl. 1. P. थर्वति, &c., to go, move.
थल्योरक: थल्योरक थल्योरक, अस्, m., N. of a village.
थड्: थड् थुड्, cl. 6. P. थुडति, &c., to cover, screen; to clothe; to hide; [cf. rt. स्थुड्।]
थोडन: थोडन, अम्, n. covering, clothing, wrapping up.
थुत्कार: थुत्कार थुत्-कार, अस्, m. the making of the sound थुत्, the sound made in spitting.
थुत्थु: थुत्थु थुत्थु (an onomatopoetic word), the sound heard in eating.
थुथुकृत्: थुथु-कृत्, त्, m. the making the imitative sound थुथु; a kind of bird (= Marāṭhī होला).
थुर्व्: थुर्व् थुर्व्, cl. 1. P. थूर्वति, तुथूर्व, &c., to hurt, injure; [cf. rt. तुर्व्।]
थूत्कार: थूत्कार थूत्-कार, अस्, m. the making of the sound थूत्, the sound made in spitting; [cf. थुत्-कार।] —थूत्-कृत, अम्, n. the sound थूत् made in spitting.
थूथू: थूथू थूथू, imitative sound of spitting; (according to others थुथु।)
थैथै: थैथै थैथै, imitative sound of a musical instrument.
